detail.longDescription: I've been out of the dev role for a few years. I'd appreciate if you could help me better understand what its actually like out there. How much are you trusting LLMs for writing production code: 1. Chat-esque LLM assistance while mostly hand writing code 2. LLM writes the code and you review line by line 3. Review mainly the high level design and tests, scanning the lower level implementation for stuff that jumps out 4. Relying on LLM generated reviews and inspecting what it highlights 5. Relying on agentic code/PR/fix loops How long ago did you hit that level of trust, was it tied to a model release? Are expectations, team norms etc forcing you to use LLMs beyond your trust in it? Have the industry changes brought more excitement about or apathy towards your work?
